MEET THE BOSS

He doesn't chase smoke. He commands it.

Every good lounge needs a name on the door and a face behind the counter. Ours built Smoke Boss from a single humidor and a folding chair into the room you're standing in now — tuxedo pressed, cigar lit, red tie never loosened.

He hand-picks every leaf that comes through that door. If it's on our shelf, the Boss smoked it first.

— The Boss
